subject: Money
title: Dubai's Boom and Bust
description: A micro-lesson that makes Dubai's Boom and Bust usable.

hook.text: Dubai built the world's tallest building during a real estate boom. Three months after completion, prices had halved.

buildup.text: Dubai transformed from a fishing village to a global hub in 20 years, fueled by oil money and speculation.

discovery.text: Foreign investors bought off-plan properties, flipping contracts before buildings were finished.

twist.text: In 2009, Dubai World asked to delay $26 billion in debt payments. The city-state nearly defaulted.

climax.text: Abu Dhabi bailed Dubai out with $10 billion. The skyline survived, but the lesson about speculation didn't stick.

punchline.text: Build the future. On borrowed money.

quiz.question: What happened to Dubai real estate prices after the Burj Khalifa was completed?
